nodes.label: Model length-fit, centering and grounding
nodes.rationale: Scales to game scale without altering real specs or physics; store camera adapts to bounding box without stretching proportions.

nodes.label: Node room server (port 3001)
nodes.rationale: Production serves dist/ and the multiplayer endpoint from the same origin; static hosting alone cannot provide rooms.

nodes.label: Code-based free-drive rooms (max 8 players)
nodes.rationale: MVP scope: small rooms identified by six-character code; collisions, accounts, shared saves, ranking, anti-cheat deliberately excluded.

nodes.label: In-memory room data
nodes.rationale: Rooms vanish on server restart; acceptable for MVP.

nodes.label: Packet shape/bounds validation (no auth)
nodes.rationale: Server validates packets but does not authenticate users or verify ownership; client positions must not drive competitive results without server-authoritative simulation.

nodes.label: Visual peer cars (client-side physics)
nodes.rationale: Each browser runs its own driving physics; server only relays snapshots, keeping server simple at the cost of authority.
